qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course (master's degree in Genetics / Plant Breeding/ Genetics and Plant Breeding / Agricultural Biotechnology). Selection through CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship/GATE or national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments (DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER, etc.). Desirable: Experience in crop genetics and breeding, field and laboratory experimentation, data analysis, documentation, and report compilation with preference for wheat diseases, molecular biology, gene mapping, and statistical analysis. Field Worker: Graduate Degree in any discipline. Desirable: Experience in field and lab work related to agriculture.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 37,000 + 27% HRA for JRF and Rs. 18,000 + 27% HRA for Field Worker

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI) for a DBT-funded project based in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this ICAR IARI notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, comprising 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post and 1 Field Worker post.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts offered in ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts offered in this recruitment notification are Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Field Worker on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course along with national-level exam qualifications like CSIR-UGC NET or GATE.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification needed for the Field Worker post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Field Worker position must hold a Graduate Degree in any discipline from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for ICAR IARI recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories and women.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary provided for Junior Research Fellow and Field Worker?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow receives Rs. 37,000 + 27% HRA per month, while the Field Worker receives Rs. 18,000 + 27% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form via email is 30 September 2026 up to 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for ICAR IARI Jobs 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through email. Candidates must send their scanned application and documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening of the received applications followed by an online or offline interview for shortlisted candidates.
